items.q: Why should I book directly 'At the Source'?
items.a: Booking directly through our official archive is the only way to secure our Best Rate Guarantee, priority for Suite Upgrades, and breakfast, "Le petit dejeuner façon toile blanche" as a gift, year-round.
A 50% prepayment is debited upon reservation. Please refer to our conditions for formal details.

Flexible: Free cancellation up to 14 days before arrival. 14–7 days: deposit retained. Less than 7 days: full stay charged.

Group (from 3 suites): Free up to 30 days before arrival.

Early Booking: Non-refundable, non-modifiable.
Extra bed: €80/night. City tax: €4.69/person/night. Private Parking: Complimentary. EV charging: €25. Bike rental: €35 half day, €49 full day.

In 2026, the property was formally declared an artwork by the Leroy Brothers. While it operates as a luxury hotel, every architectural and horticultural choice is a permanent part of the archival record.

items.q: Can I visit the art without staying?
items.a: The gardens and 'The Archive' are open to our restaurant guests. For formal gallery visits, please refer to Toile Blanche Contemporary.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in: 16:00–20:00. Check-out: 08:00–11:00. Guests booking 'At the Source' receive priority for early arrival and the Pénéquet (late check-out) when available.

items.q: Is there a shuttle from Nice Airport?
items.a: The property is 20 minutes from NCE. We can arrange a private transfer for approximately €60. Our concierge will handle the coordination.

Le Restaurant: Dinner 19:30–21:30.
La Guinguette: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (Winter) / 12:00–22:00 (Summer). Open daily.

items.q: Can I bring outside food or wine?
items.a: As each suite features a curated Maxibar with full bottles from local domains and artisanal provisions, we kindly request that no outside groceries or beverages are consumed in the common areas or suites.
We provide secure, private outdoor parking within the walls of the property, free of charge for our guests.
The pools are heated from mid-April, weather and temperatures permitting. They remain open for cold plunges during the winter months, for the brave.
We welcome children with specific guidelines for the harmony of Toile Blanche. Pets, however, are not permitted within the houses of Toile Blanche.
